question: In which of the following states/union territories was the world’s longest highway tunnel opened in October 2020?
solution:
The answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Tunnel:**

 
 
• **Longest highway tunnel above 10,000 ft in the world**
 
• **Length:** 9.02 km
 
• **Location:** Below the Rohtang Pass,** Himachal Pradesh**
 
• Connect: Manali to Lahaul-Spiti Valley (Distance reduced: 46 km)
 
• **Altitude: 3,100 metres (10,171 ft) above mean sea level**
 
• Constructed by: Border Roads Organisation (BRO)
 
• In 2002, Atal Bihari Vajpayee laid the foundation stone for the approach road to the tunnel.
 
• Atal Tunnel was inaugurated by Prime Minister, Narendra Modi on 3 October 2020.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Tunnel:**

 
 
• **Longest road tunnel in India**
 
• **Length:** 9.28 km
 
• **Location: Jammu and Kashmir**
 
• Connect: Chenani to Nashri
 
• **It is located in the Lower Himalayas, on National Highway 44.**
 
 
 
• **Longest electrified rail tunnel in India:**
 
 
• **Length: **6.6 km
 
• **Location: Between Cherlopalli and Rapuru stations of Andhra Pradesh.**
